summary.business_type: B2B Custom Sportswear & Apparel Manufacturer / Wholesale
top_findings: Critical: Missing <link rel="canonical"> tags site-wide, leading to potential duplicate content risks between www/non-www and trailing slash variations.
High: Product dynamic routes (/products/[productId]) lack generateMetadata(), causing all 180+ product pages to serve duplicate root titles and meta descriptions.
High: Missing OpenGraph & Twitter image tags (og:image / twitter:image) across pages, causing link shares on WhatsApp/LinkedIn/Twitter to fail card rendering.
Medium: Missing Product, Offer, and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD schema on product catalog pages.
Medium: Sitemap lacks <lastmod> timestamps across all 181 entries, degrading search engine crawl efficiency.
Medium: AI Search Readiness (GEO) lacks llms.txt and Content-Signal declarations for search agents.
quick_wins: Add metadataBase and alternates.canonical in src/app/layout.tsx to instantly fix canonical URLs site-wide.
Export generateMetadata in src/app/products/[productId]/page.tsx using existing product data to give each product unique title, description, and OG image.
Add default og:image to root metadata pointing to /hero-montage.png or /brand/logo-256.png.
Create public/llms.txt summarizing Force Sports products, B2B wholesale minimums, and fabric technology for AI Overviews and perplexity.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Vercel CDN hosting provides fast TTFB (<200ms) with global edge caching
Valid robots.txt properly referencing sitemap.xml with no blocking rules
Clean 308 permanent redirect from non-www to www
Proper HTML viewport declaration for mobile responsiveness

findings.title: Missing Canonical Tag (<link rel='canonical'>)
findings.description: Neither homepage nor interior pages declare a canonical URL tag.
findings.recommendation: Configure metadataBase and alternates: { canonical: './' } in Next.js layout.tsx.

findings.title: Missing <lastmod> in sitemap.xml
findings.description: All 181 URLs in sitemap.xml omit <lastmod> dates.
findings.recommendation: Inject ISO 8601 <lastmod>YYYY-MM-DD</lastmod> tags in sitemap generation.

findings.title: Missing Security & Privacy Headers
findings.description: X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, and X-Frame-Options headers are not explicitly declared in next.config or vercel.json.
findings.recommendation: Add security headers in next.config.mjs headers() configuration.

categories.name: On-Page & Content Quality
what_works: Single, clear <h1> on homepage ('Force Sports & Wears India')
Structured <h2> headings covering key B2B value propositions, fabric tech, and sportswear categories
32 of 36 images have descriptive alt attributes

findings.title: Duplicate Metadata on All 180+ Product Pages
findings.description: /products/[productId] lacks dynamic generateMetadata(), reusing the default homepage title and description for every individual product.
findings.recommendation: Implement generateMetadata in src/app/products/[productId]/page.tsx using product details.

findings.title: Homepage Meta Description Exceeds Recommended Length
findings.description: Current description is 207 characters; search engines truncate at ~155-160 characters on desktop/mobile.
findings.recommendation: Trim homepage description to 150-160 high-impact characters.

findings.title: Missing Alt Text on 4 Images
findings.description: 4 decorative/content images on homepage lack alt text.
findings.recommendation: Add descriptive alt attributes to remaining elements.

categories.name: Structured Data & Schema
what_works: Rich Organization and SportsStore/Manufacturer schema on homepage
Includes geo-coordinates, operating hours, full address, phone number, and foundingDate
Includes sameAs linking to Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and IndiaMart
Includes knowsAbout list with 15 targeted sportswear entities

findings.title: Missing Product & Offer Schema on Catalog Pages
findings.description: Product pages render Organization schema instead of schema.org/Product with offers, availability, and brand.
findings.recommendation: Add JSON-LD Product schema component to ProductDetailPage.

findings.title: Missing BreadcrumbList Schema
findings.description: Nested routes (/products/..., /catalog/..., /ispo/...) do not declare BreadcrumbList markup.
findings.recommendation: Implement breadcrumbs schema across multi-level pages for Google search breadcrumb rich snippets.

categories.name: Social & Sharing (OpenGraph)
what_works: og:title, og:description, and og:site_name present on homepage

findings.title: Missing og:image and twitter:image
findings.description: Social meta tags lack image URLs, causing link shares to display without a visual thumbnail.
findings.recommendation: Set openGraph.images in layout.tsx pointing to high-resolution branding graphics.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness & GEO
what_works: Static prerendering ensures full HTML and text content are crawlable without JS execution
Robots.txt reachable and allows all search bots

findings.title: Missing llms.txt Discovery File
findings.description: No /llms.txt file is published for LLM search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Claude).
findings.recommendation: Place standard llms.txt in public/ summarizing manufacturing facilities, capacity, fabric specs, and ordering contact.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Technical Fixes
items: Configure metadataBase and alternates: { canonical: './' } in src/app/layout.tsx
Add openGraph.images and twitter.images in src/app/layout.tsx

phases.name: Phase 2: Structured Data & Catalog Enhancement
items: Add schema.org/Product structured data to product detail views
Add BreadcrumbList schema to catalog and category routes

phases.name: Phase 3: AI Search (GEO) & Content Optimization
items: Deploy /public/llms.txt with brand and B2B catalog summary
Optimize homepage meta description length to under 160 characters
